cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology for missing my birthday can cover Boxing Day here. Arrival by noon; an evening visit isn't a day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come at noon. Will you tell Mum we're all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That is a separate request. Stay for dinner and I'll tell her there's no bad feeling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want there actually to be no bad feeling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay through New Year. Please don't ask for the full reconciliation at the reassuring-phone-call rate.
